text: {"lessons":["Selling Stock E in several small profitable trades felt satisfying, but I should avoid letting the pleasure of locking in gains dictate my allocation; use a clear target instead.","Buying Stock A and Stock B after gains, then holding through a decline, reminds me to size purchases deliberately and accept that prices can move against me without panic.","My infrequent trading suits me better than reacting to each monthly change; review the whole portfolio and my long-term plan before making a trade."]}
